purpose: Approved visual handoff; implementation requires current repository audit. Not a running product or API specification.
audit_limits: Audit is pinned to anchor commit, not current deployment.
First inspect current HEAD, existing routes, API contracts, migrations, roles, object scopes, tests, and open implementation work.
No live build, deployed UI, physical device, camera, GPS, printer, or backend contract verified by this package.

status_legend.current: Existing screen family verified at audit anchor; reference is a redesigned presentation, not proof all controls work.
status_legend.rework: Existing feature plus redesign or additional requested behavior; reconcile differences before wiring.
status_legend.requested: User-requested behavior not verified at audit anchor; implement only with explicit domain and permission decisions.

binding_policy.authorization_rule: Union of actual assigned role permissions plus actual object scope, enforced by server. Auditor remains read-only. No new role or permission inferred from labels.
